body.statement: For every triangular array in \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{dense}}\), \[\frac{\widehat\tau_n-\tau_n}{\sigma_n}\rightsquigarrow\mathcal N(0,1).\] The only randomness is \((\mathbf A_n,\mathbf Z_n)\); the composition-indexed potential outcomes are fixed, and the Lindeberg condition is derived in \(\mathrm{Lemma}~\ref{lem:reveal-increment-bound}\) rather than assumed.
body.justification: Centered Gaussian inference survives dense global dependence when the actual reveal martingale has stable predictable variation.
body.gap: LiDing2017, Theorem 4, handles complete treatment randomization conditional on fixed experimental units; Ohlsson1989 handles conventional two-stage sampling; neither covers composition-indexed scores generated by a positive-fraction disjoint partition.
body.consumer: The result supplies design-based normal inference for PAME when independent-group coupling is asymptotically invalid.
